title: MOM
description:
In this story, you will control Riley, a girl who has noticed a grotesque change in her mother’s behavior over time, putting her in various challenging situations from which you must help her escape unharmed.

Will you be able to uncover what Mom is hiding?

• Immerse yourself in a disturbing atmosphere of terror as you solve puzzles within the house and explore other maps.

• Featuring pixel art graphics inspired by classic horror works.

• A dark narrative filled with secrets surrounding your own mother.

• The use of headphones is highly recommended for an immersive experience.

• Experience around 2 hours of horror, packed with a diverse range of maps and puzzles.                                  

                                       WHY ISN'T MOM SLEEPING?
description_short: Mom says I can't get out of my room after 12:00 AM. But I always hear the door opening and closing after that hour. Why isn't mom sleeping?
